name: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 4.14, price over EPS 4.85); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2023, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the balance-sheet multiples stand on FY2023
